semantics.clock: posedge clk, matching original always @(posedge clk)
semantics.equation: At each rising edge, if L then Q <= r_in; else Q <= q_in.
semantics.evidence: Original full_module loads r when L is asserted; otherwise each flip-flop receives its corresponding feedback expression through q_in.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior in original specification.
semantics.initialization: No initial assignment in original module; Q is unknown until first capture.
semantics.between_edges: Q retains the last captured value; input changes and falling clock edges do not update Q.
semantics.latency: One flip-flop only; captured value appears after nonblocking update at the same rising edge.

numeric.interpretation: Bit values; no arithmetic, signed conversion, rounding, overflow, or saturation.
numeric.feedback: XOR and inter-flip-flop routing belong in full_module, not this scalar submodule.

verification.oracle: Derived independently from original full_module load/feedback selection and posedge semantics.
coverage: Input mutation while clock low and high
Three-instance factoring for all eight r vectors and feedback sequences
verification.sampling: Drive away from rising edge; check retention before edge and outputs after NBA with delay.
verification.failure: Case-inequality comparisons, $fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, final PASS only after all checks.
